checks.name: wasi
checks.command:
$env:CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_WASIP2_RUNNER = 'wasmtime run'
cargo test --locked -p nepl3-core -p nepl3-reader -p nepl3-wire -p nepl3-engine -p nepl3-grammar-core --target wasm32-wasip2 -- --test-threads=1

checks.name: wasm
checks.command: cargo check --locked -p nepl3-core -p nepl3-reader -p nepl3-wire -p nepl3-engine -p nepl3-grammar-core --no-default-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown

checks.name: audit

python tools/audit/structure.py
python -m unittest discover -s tools/audit -p test.py
python tools/generate/grammar.py
python -m unittest discover -s tools/bootstrap -p test_grammar.py
